decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - 4.	Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification, no windows/openings other than those hereby approved shall be inserted or constructed at any time in the east/west flank elevations of the rear extensions hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - 5.	The window panes of the new ground-floor windows in the east/flank elevation of the dwelling hereby permitted shall be obscurely glazed up to a height of 1.7 m above the floor level of the rooms in which these windows are installed, and shall be non-opening or top-hung below this height. These windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise in accordance with these requirements.

Condition : 6 - 6.	The flat roof area above the ground-floor rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a part two storey part single storey rear extension, part single storey front extension incorporating conversion of part garage into habitable room, erection of a front porch and wheelchair adaptions, installation of door and window replacements to the house
